### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the challenge is. Ex. *"Our company needs to sync attendance logs from ZKTeco biometric devices."*

### Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen. What would the UI or workflow look like?

### Target Module
- [ ] Core HR & Employee Profiles
- [ ] Time & Attendance (Biometrics)
- [ ] Payroll & Expenses
- [ ] Performance Appraisals
- [ ] Recruitment & ATS
- [ ] Enterprise Security & Directory (LDAP/SAML)
- [ ] Other (Specify below)

### Business & Community Impact
How will this feature benefit other organizations using Sentrifugo Modern?

### Sponsorship / Contribution
- [ ] I am willing to contribute code/PR for this feature.
- [ ] My organization is interested in sponsoring or pledging a bounty for this feature milestone via [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh).
